//: A workspace member so `@nts/config` resolves the way it would for a user: as a dependency, through node's own resolution, rather than through a tsconfig path or a loader hook. `nts build` evaluates `nts.config.ts` with node, and node has no `paths`.
//hoisted: One package.json at the root of the fixture rather than twenty. Node walks up from `apps/native/nts.config.ts` through `apps/node_modules` to this one, which is what a monorepo with a hoisted dependency looks like -- and is why the apps and packages need none of their own.
name: @nts-examples/workspace
